comment: Ha, I already left over the AI slop, so one more dollar is the least of it. The money barely reaches artists anyway, so a price hike just means more of my cash going nowhere. Not paying for that.
Free plan is already locked down and now Premium goes up another dollar. Why do I have to keep paying for stuff that should just come with the app? Ridiculous at this point.

Price goes up while lossless is still a slow, half-baked rollout? Tidal already gives me real lossless for about the same money. I still like Spotify's recommendations, but paying more for lossy streams is hard to swallow.
Honestly still worth it for me. 12.99 is cheaper than buying the albums I listen to, and ad-free plus downloads is why I pay. Pricey, sure, but no complaints here.

Paying more on the family plan while the app still can't show a proper discography? Fuck that. Fix the artist pages first, then talk about price. We're on the family plan so I'm watching this closely.
lol price goes up and the queue still restarts songs? wtf. Lossless sounds great when it works but I'm starting to look at Apple Music if the bugs don't get sorted. Fix the app before charging more.
Price went up, cool. I'm on 320 over Bluetooth anyway so nobody can hear the difference. As long as the library tools work I don't really care.

Family plan just went up again. Per person it's still cheap, but that's another bump and there's still no lossless on family. We'll stay because switching six people is a nightmare, but it's getting annoying.

Paying more for Premium while Spotify still shoves its own ads into my podcasts? That's a paid plan with ads. Some of you already moved to Pocket Casts for this reason. One more unskippable ad and I'm deleting this account.
Student goes up to 6.99? Still way cheaper than full price, but I'm nervous about whether the Hulu bundle changes when they reprice. Anyone know if Hulu stays included? Still a student for now.
Premium is already $12 and the free tier is basically unusable. I'm just going to buy YouTube Premium instead, same price and I get videos too. Free Spotify is ass.
Third cost increase and I still think it's a bargain. Nearly all the music ever made, ad-free and offline, for less than a CD a month. Paying more also helps artists. Worth it for me.
Raising prices while AI slop floods Discover Weekly and artists get pennies? Nah. I already left and this just confirms it. Pay the artists, not the fake ghost accounts.
Duo going up again. I'll pay if the features I'm waiting for actually show up on my account, but Discover Weekly still doesn't refresh half the time. Hard pass if nothing lands.
Price keeps climbing and the algorithm sucks now. Jam is the only thing keeping me here, and YouTube Music is already in my YouTube Premium. Once the same songs keep repeating I'm moving.

Premium goes up AGAIN and shuffle still plays the same 10-15 songs out of a 9,000 track playlist. Smart shuffle is broken. I pay for repeat and in-order play, not this. Cancelled once already, could do it again.
Premium price up again and songs still won't play the next track. Amazon Music is cheaper and my playlists are already there. Reinstalled twice, support was useless. Cancelling premium and moving.
Prices up again and the app still hides features I used to have. Crossfade is fine but they keep ruining stuff. Absolute garbage, enshittification continues.
Still a steal at 12.99. Worth every penny for the family plan, with podcasts, audiobooks and music in one app. The yearly bumps are annoying but I'm not switching for a few quid.

So Premium is going up again in February. Does the new price hit people on multi-month blocks too, or only monthly? I already got charged after cancelling once, so please make sure we don't get charged early. Support just sends copy-paste replies.
Price going up while the same bug is still there after my third reinstall. Feels bad paying for something that doesn't work. Hopefully it gets fixed soon, but if not I'm moving to YouTube Music.

I'm on free so this doesn't hit me directly, but Premium going up again while my playlists still reset to random songs? Is anyone else seeing this? I already switched to Apple Music for a bit when playback broke, so if it keeps going I'll do it again.
Same price as everyone else but still region-locked on lossless and AI playlists, and now the price goes up again. Worth its weight in gold for my parents, but I'm tired of these arbitrary rollouts.

Eh. I've paid for over a decade and I need the library for transcribing anyway, so the bump doesn't change much. Still wish Discover Weekly would stop recycling the same top 40. Love the library, meh on the recs.

Price up again, meh. Moving years of playlists elsewhere would be way more painful than paying a bit more, so I'm keeping the subscription. Still wish I could play one artist's songs without the whole discography.
Spotify raises prices again and artists still get pennies for their streams. Where does the extra money go? Probably the CEO's pocket. I'm already buying music directly and I'll keep doing it.
Spotify is going up again and Apple Music is still cheaper with better sound. I'm stuck with Spotify for the playlists right now, but if the same songs keep repeating I'm moving.

Price going up in February, which is annoying when the podcast feed still plays episodes in reverse. I love the UI and keep my playlists here, so I'm staying for now. If the podcast side doesn't get fixed I'll move to Pocket Casts.
